correctness.rationale: The radial eigenvalue (m+1)b can collide only with one b+aμ_j. An interior frequency gives a merged space of dimension three; the even alternating endpoint gives dimension two. PBH requires these dimensions and the proposed adjacent-rim placements attain them: the hub detects the radial coefficient when fused with an interior mode, and an adjacent rim pair separates the alternating and radial columns at the even endpoint. Hub-containing pairs fail on the two-dimensional rim mode. Sine restrictions vanish iff m divides 2jt, giving the stated three gcd conditions and counts by counting eligible ordered differences and dividing by two. At prime rim order, three rim points yield a nonsingular affine circle sample and the hub plus any pair yields a nonzero sine minor; the other eigenspaces restrict injectively as well. Independent exact rational checks of all pairs in seven instances (including m=4 endpoint and m=9 interior) passed; replay: /workspace/independent_checks.py. The supplied finite verification is not the proof.

originality.rationale: The complete finding is covered by the distinct, stronger Resultary theorem 52ce2e4d87c4. Divide the Laplacian by a and set its spoke weight t=b/a; controllability is unchanged by this drift scaling. The stronger theorem gives the same threshold, pair conditions and counts, and a necessary-and-sufficient classification of optimal triples for all rim orders. Primality makes both its gcd and residue tests automatic, giving every prime-order triple and hence its count. This is demonstrated statement-level coverage. The November directory date and frozen October date alone do not settle first discovery, dependence or priority; failure is for distinctness against the verified published coverage, not a claim about who discovered it first.
